name: THE ARSENAL
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: THE ARSENAL (Paolo 7/5/26, engine/bohemia_overmap.js): 'the range that houses tanks + helicopters, one block off the strip on the rail side (real: behind Circus Circus). The Remnants saw it as super important; contested with the cartel.'

A shooting range is a firing line of booths, lanes downrange to the backstop (a sand berm or a steel bullet trap), target stands on their frames and drill barricades in the lanes; behind the line the counter with its glass cases and the racks. Its display hall holds the vehicles.

A main battle tank is about 10 metres long with its gun and 2.4 high; a Huey's fuselage about 12.7 metres; a Humvee about 4.6 long and 1.8 high: on house tiles each is a run of tiles nobody stands on and nobody sees through.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (arsenal_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The arsenal is its own map kind, one cell: eight fights in ten there are fought inside it, by the cell's own dice; the rest in its yard.
share_dice: THE MAP'S DICE (COMBAT FOUR 11/22): a place's inside is rolled from its cell (the same cell the same answer), so a place on a few cells goes inside on a step, never a slope: 'share' is the threshold its real cells need for 'share_meant' to come true over a whole run of valleys, measured on the map's own cells (gates/the_big_insides_gate.js I14). arsenal: meant 0.8, went inside in 100% of its cells over 40 valleys (5 places, 40 cells, after what the parking garage takes first); at 0.74, 72%, the nearest its dice allow.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The arsenal's block wall: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The range's floor, brass underfoot, or the hall's concrete: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

backstop.effect: The backstop at the end of the lanes, steel plate over a bank of sand: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

targets.effect: Target stands on their frames, the paper shot to rags: low cover.

booths.effect: A shooting booth on the firing line, its baffled partitions and its shelf: cover. [bb] its palisade.

counter.effect: The range's counter, its glass cases smashed and empty: cover.

racks.effect: Steel gun racks to the ceiling, stripped bare: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through them. [bb] its wall.

ammo.effect: Ammunition crates, steel cans in wooden cases, empty: cover.

sandbags.effect: A sandbag wall, waist high: low cover. [bb] its palisade, waist high.

barricade.effect: A drill barricade in the lane, plywood on a frame: low cover.

tank.effect: A tank on display, its tracks on blocks: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

helicopter.effect: A helicopter's fuselage on display, its rotor tied down: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

humvee.effect: A Humvee on display, its tyres flat: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

drums.effect: Oil drums and fuel cans: low cover.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The arsenal's doors, or the hall's roll-up door, open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in arsenal_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: a tank's deck is a climb nobody gets onto under fire on house tiles; the vehicles are blockers.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the range's overhead baffles and the hall's trusses, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
